caption: The drawing depicts a section of an interior wall that is elaborately decorated. At the center of the composition is a tall, brown wooden door with visible texture and a rectangular panel design. Surrounding the door, the wall is covered in a pattern of small, rectangular beige tiles bordered by intricate green, red, and dark brown floral or scroll-like patterns. Two symmetrical light fixtures are mounted on either side of the door, each with three white bulbs or globes and brass or gold bases on oval plaques. Below the tiled area along the bottom of the wall, there is a horizontal band of greenish marble or faux-marble paneling, divided into sections, and a thin brown baseboard runs at the floor level. The top of the wall features a wide decorative frieze or cornice band with wavy green, white, and red motifs repeating across its length against a beige tile background, matching the tiles below. The composition and colors are precise and even, with a focus on symmetry and ornate detail.
title: Marble Mosaic Wall
